title: prefer radios over dropdowns when visible
name: Prefer radios over dropdowns when visible
rule: Prefer radios over dropdowns when options can stay visible.
pass_when: A set that can stay visible is radios (or equivalent exposed list), not a dropdown.
fail_when: Options that fit on screen are hidden in a dropdown.
overview: Prefer radios over dropdowns when the option set can stay visible.
apply_when: Option sets that fit on screen and can remain exposed.
not_when: Hiding on-screen-fitting options inside a dropdown.
agent_hint: Use radios or an exposed list when options can stay visible; avoid dropdowns.
description: When options can stay visible on screen, prefer radios or an equivalent exposed list over a dropdown. Pass when a set that can stay visible is radios or equivalent, not a dropdown. Fail when options that fit on screen are hidden in a dropdown, forcing an extra open step for a small visible set that could have stayed exposed.
